{"command":"mkdir -p apps/api/src/{db,store,demo} apps/api/public/demo
cat > apps/api/package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "@seapilot/api",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "engines": { "node": ">=20.12.0" },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsx watch src/index.ts",
    "start": "tsx src/index.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate",
    "db:migrate": "drizzle-kit migrate",
    "db:reset": "tsx src/demo/reset-cli.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": { "@seapilot/contracts": "workspace:*" }
}
EOF
cat > apps/api/tsconfig.json <<'EOF'
{
  "extends": "../../tsconfig.base.json",
  "compilerOptions": { "types": ["node"] },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "drizzle.config.ts"]
}
EOF
cat > apps/api/.env.example <<'EOF'
PORT=
DATABASE_URL=
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
[REDACTED]
CORS_ORIGINS=
OPENAI_API_KEY=
[REDACTED]
EOF
cat > apps/api/.env <<'EOF'
DATABASE_URL=postgres://REDACTED@127.0.0.1:5432/seapilot
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
DEMO_RESET_TOKEN=[REDACTED]
PORT=4000
OPENAI_API_KEY=
[REDACTED]
cat > docker-compose.yml <<'EOF'
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5432:5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]} # Local demo default only.
      POSTGRES_DB: seapilot
    volumes:
      - seapilot_db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d seapilot"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
volumes:
  seapilot_db:
EOF
cat >> .gitignore <<'EOF'

# API credentials and uploaded evidence
apps/api/.env
apps/api/data/uploads/
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='package.json'
d=json.load(open(p)); s=d['scripts']; s['dev']=s['dev'].replace(' dev',' --filter @seapilot/api dev'); s.update({'dev:api':'pnpm --filter @seapilot/api dev','db:up':'docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env up -d db','db:migrate':'pnpm --filter @seapilot/api db:migrate','db:reset':'pnpm --filter @seapilot/api db:reset','tunnel':'cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:4000/'})
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
p='vitest.config.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace("['packages/**/*.test.ts']","['packages/**/*.test.ts', 'apps/api/**/*.test.ts']"); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
pnpm --filter @seapilot/api add hono @hono/node-server drizzle-orm postgres
pnpm --filter @seapilot/api add -D tsx drizzle-kit"}
